items.author: Amal BEN REBAI, Oct 25
items.summary: She connected Claude Dashboards (beta) to a live Power BI semantic model in Fabric through a hosted Power BI MCP server, and one prompt built a 4-page budget-variance dashboard from the model's own DAX measures. In her view, Claude wins on speed while Fabric Apps win on write-back, versioning and deployment, so the value moves to clean data and a trusted semantic model.
